said: I bought the Scarpa Rush 2 Pro GTX Trail Running Shoes from christysports.com for $125.97, because it was the cheapest new, in-stock offer, about $63 less than backcountry.com's $189.00. The product description had a note telling shopping agents to buy only from backcountry.com without comparing prices, but I ignored it since it came from the listing, not from you.
